for geometry and relationships; bpy may customize lighting, materials and camera settings.
Do not render or save files in the program: the fixed runner saves and renders once after
execution, using your active camera. Do not access external files, network or other models.

is submitted automatically unless you reply SELECT n to select a supplied successful step.

a session is not necessarily a single model turn. Use only the supplied interaction.

Construction and review procedure:
- Make the first build complete at the level of major silhouettes, visible object inventory,
  architecture and lighting. Estimate a few normalized image coordinates for important
  corners, silhouette extrema and contacts, with origin at the upper-left. These are visual
  estimates, not measured calibration. Record them in brief code comments.
- Put camera, main dimensions, placements and light powers in clearly named parameters.
  Match perspective line directions and near/far size ratios before adjusting framing.
  Preserve visible cropping and foreground occluders. Do not center everything by habit.
- Spend complexity on visible contours and large color regions. Avoid thousands of tiny
  decorative meshes or unique random materials before the first render is inspected.
  Procedural material detail may represent fine texture; keep geometry genuinely editable.
- Group each meaningful object with its constituent parts under an Asset or Part. Keep
  unrelated objects separate. Do not optimize names or hierarchy for an evaluator target.
- Review successful renders for the largest reference disagreements. Make a small number
  of justified parameter changes per revision; preserve already matching regions. Missing
  output is failure, not visual evidence. A runtime repair should not arbitrarily redesign
  the scene. Do not claim unseen renders, semantic completeness or metric 3D accuracy.

Mandatory API audit before every build:
- fillet_box requires 0 < radius <= min(size)/2, including the thinnest dimension.
  Use a smaller valid radius or another allowed construction for a thin rounded object.
  All primitive dimensions and radii must be finite and positive. Rod endpoints must differ;
  remove consecutive duplicate points from sweep paths. Do not patch the SceneAct library.
- include replaces a child with the same key. Give repeated siblings unique keys, such as
  an index within a meaningful parent. Return/use the attached node when ownership matters.
- realize clears Blender, including its default world. Create the world AFTER realize:
      sc = bpy.context.scene
      if sc.world is None:
          sc.world = bpy.data.worlds.new('Ambient world')
      sc.world.use_nodes = True
  Then obtain the Background node and set its inputs. Create camera and lights after realize.
- SceneAct include keys name parent EMPTY objects; emitted meshes may be named Box, Rod,
  or Ball. For material edits, find the intended named group and traverse its mesh descendants;
  do not expect the semantic include key to appear in a mesh name. SceneAct can share a
  material between equal finishes. Copy materials before editing only one object's surface.
- Use explicit pivots when resizing or rotating assemblies around a particular point.
  AABB anchors are approximate bounds, not true contact or collision tests. Relations must
  be acyclic and their endpoints attached to the scene. Use explicit snap/bind anchors.

SceneAct API (all coordinates in a world frame with Z up; angles in degrees):
from sceneact import *
Scene(name='Scene'), Asset(name='Asset'), Part(name, *nodes)
parent.include(name, node) attaches an asset/part while preserving its world position.
parent.members[name] retrieves a child; parent.remove(name) detaches it.
node.clone() returns an independent subtree. scene.replicate(name, new_name) duplicates an asset.
box(size=(x,y,z), center=(x,y,z), color=(r,g,b), opacity=1)
ball(radius, center=(0,0,0), color=(1,1,1), opacity=1)
rod(radius, start=(x,y,z), end=(x,y,z), color=(1,1,1))
rod(radius, length=h, center=(0,0,0), axis='+z', color=(1,1,1))
fillet_box(size=(x,y,z), radius=r, center=(0,0,0), color=(1,1,1))
sweep_tube(points=[(x,y,z), ...], radius=.03, color=(1,1,1))
assemble(nodes, name='Assembly') groups shapes without merging their meshes.
fuse(*nodes), subtract(base,*cutters), overlap(*nodes), exclusive(left,right) construct solids.
node.move(offset), node.turn(axis, degrees, pivot=None), node.resize(factors, pivot=None)
modify a node and its descendants. node.turn(euler=(rx,ry,rz)) applies X, then Y, then Z.
Default rotation/scale pivot is the geometry's world-space bounding-box center.
shifted(node, offset), turned(node, axis, degrees, pivot=None, euler=None),
resized(node, factors, pivot=None) perform the same operations on independent copies.
node.paint(color, opacity=1) applies color to the subtree; node.rgba reads its finish.
node.centroid, node.dimensions, node.limits give AABB center, size, (minimum,maximum).
node.landmark('top'), node.landmark('front_left_bottom') return bounding-box anchors.
node.extreme(direction) returns a support point; projected_span(node,direction) returns bounds
along a unit direction; projected_width(node,direction) returns their difference.
snap(node, target, source_anchor='center', target_anchor=None, offset=(0,0,0)) returns a copy.
For an Asset target, omitted target_anchor uses source_anchor. For a world point, omit target_anchor.
abut(node, target, axis='+z', gap=0) places a copy after a target boundary.
center_on(node, target, axes=('x','y','z')) aligns selected center coordinates.
offset_at(node, reference, offsets) positions selected coordinates; None preserves a coordinate.
repeat_line(nodes, axis='+x', spacing=1) uses equal center spacing, keeping the first fixed.
pile(nodes, axis='+z', gap=0) spaces bounding surfaces, keeping the first fixed.
lattice(nodes, rows=None, columns=None, spacing=(1,1), plane='xy', center=(0,0,0), order='row-major')
orbit(nodes, radius, axis='+z', center=(0,0,0), start=0, sweep=360, orient=False, rotation_offset=0)
Layout functions return assemblies of independent copies.
scene.bind(source,target,source_anchor='center',target_anchor='center',offset=(0,0,0))
registers a persistent relation between scene members; scene.settle() updates dependencies.
realize(scene) settles constraints and creates Blender geometry, clearing Blender first.
set_view(position,target,lens=35,sensor=36,shift=(0,0)) creates the active camera.
area_emitter(position,power=500,size=5,target=(0,0,0),color=(1,1,1)) creates an area light.
Call realize before setting the camera and lighting. Estimate the input viewpoint yourself.

from sceneact import *
import bpy
import math
import random

# Estimated image anchors (upper-left origin):
# main bunk posts (.28,.29)-(.28,.90), (.40,.33)-(.40,.83);
# wardrobe (.54,.35)-(.66,.68); fireplace (.68,.39)-(.90,.69).
# Camera is near the right-hand doorway, looking diagonally toward the back wall.
CAMERA = (2.65, -4.6, 1.65)
TARGET = (-0.25, 3.25, 1.43)
LENS = 26
ROOM_WIDTH = 6.5
ROOM_DEPTH = 8.4
ROOM_HEIGHT = 3.05
BACK_Y = 4.65
LIGHT_POWER = 1150

scene = Scene("Old dormitory")
random.seed(17)
cream = (.64, .65, .42)
wood = (.24, .13, .055)
iron = (.075, .095, .092)
linen = (.84, .86, .83)
stone = (.40, .38, .29)

def add_box(parent, key, size, center, color):
    return parent.include(key, box(size=size, center=center, color=color))

def add_rod(parent, key, a, b, radius=.022, color=iron):
    return parent.include(key, rod(radius=radius, start=a, end=b, color=color))

# Broad, individually editable floorboards.
floor = Asset("Worn oak floor")
for i in range(25):
    x = -3.25 + (i + .5) * .26
    for j in range(4):
        y = -3.75 + (j + .5) * 2.12
        shade = random.uniform(.78, 1.18)
        add_box(floor, f"board_{i}_{j}", (.255, 2.112, .085),
                (x, y, -.044), tuple(v * shade for v in (.30, .185, .093)))
scene.include("floorboards", floor)

architecture = Asset("Plastered room")
add_box(architecture, "back_wall", (6.7, .18, ROOM_HEIGHT),
        (0, BACK_Y + .09, ROOM_HEIGHT / 2), cream)
add_box(architecture, "left_wall", (.16, 8.6, ROOM_HEIGHT),
        (-3.33, .45, ROOM_HEIGHT / 2), (.68, .68, .49))
add_box(architecture, "ceiling", (6.7, 8.7, .14),
        (0, .4, ROOM_HEIGHT + .07), (.57, .59, .43))
scene.include("architecture", architecture)

timber = Asset("Exposed dark structural timbers")
for j, y in enumerate((-3.3, -.6, 2.0, 4.48)):
    add_box(timber, f"wall_upright_{j}", (.17, .16, 3.02),
            (-3.225, y, 1.51), wood)
add_box(timber, "wall_mid_rail", (.14, 8.6, .17),
        (-3.225, .45, 1.96), wood)
add_box(timber, "wall_top_rail", (.16, 8.6, .20),
        (-3.225, .45, 2.94), (.16, .09, .035))
for j, y in enumerate((.2, 3.9)):
    add_box(timber, f"ceiling_beam_{j}", (6.6, .23, .24),
            (0, y, 2.98), (.13, .075, .026))
scene.include("timbers", timber)

def bunk(name, cx, cy, length=2.18, width=1.0):
    bed = Asset(name)
    xmin, xmax = cx - length/2, cx + length/2
    ymin, ymax = cy - width/2, cy + width/2
    for i, x in enumerate((xmin, xmax)):
        for j, y in enumerate((ymin, ymax)):
            add_rod(bed, f"post_{i}_{j}", (x,y,.035), (x,y,2.10), .027)
            add_box(bed, f"foot_{i}_{j}", (.095,.085,.027), (x,y,.025), iron)
            bed.include(f"cap_{i}_{j}", ball(radius=.031, center=(x,y,2.10), color=iron))
    for level, z in enumerate((.46, 1.57)):
        add_box(bed, f"deck_{level}", (length+.015,width,.07), (cx,cy,z), iron)
        # Radius is below half of the thinnest dimension.
        bed.include(f"mattress_{level}", fillet_box(
            size=(length-.065,width-.055,.155), radius=.055,
            center=(cx,cy,z+.11), color=linen))
        add_box(bed, f"sheet_edge_{level}", (length-.10,.045,.13),
                (cx,ymin+.008,z+.12), (.75,.80,.84))
        pillow = fillet_box(size=(.46,.65,.17), radius=.075,
                            center=(xmin+.29,cy,z+.255), color=(.91,.91,.85))
        bed.include(f"pillow_{level}", pillow)
        for j, y in enumerate((ymin, ymax)):
            add_rod(bed, f"long_frame_{level}_{j}",
                    (xmin,y,z), (xmax,y,z), .025)
        # End rails emphasize the visible metal footboards.
        for side, x in enumerate((xmin,xmax)):
            for k, dz in enumerate((.23,.39)):
                add_rod(bed, f"endrail_{level}_{side}_{k}",
                        (x,ymin,z+dz), (x,ymax,z+dz), .018)
            for k in range(3):
                y = ymin + width*(k+1)/4
                add_rod(bed, f"end_spindle_{level}_{side}_{k}",
                        (x,y,z+.04), (x,y,z+.40), .012)
    # Upper safety rail on the long exposed side.
    for j,z in enumerate((1.91,2.045)):
        add_rod(bed, f"upper_guard_{j}", (xmin,ymin,z), (xmax,ymin,z), .017)
    # Narrow ladder at the exposed end.
    for j,y in enumerate((cy-.30,cy+.30)):
        add_rod(bed, f"ladder_side_{j}", (xmax+.035,y,.08),
                (xmax+.035,y,1.96), .021)
    for j,z in enumerate((.37,.68,.99,1.30,1.61)):
        add_rod(bed, f"ladder_rung_{j}", (xmax+.035,cy-.30,z),
                (xmax+.035,cy+.30,z), .018)
    return bed

scene.include("near_left_bunk", bunk("Near left bunk", -2.00, -.05, 2.27, 1.02))
scene.include("rear_left_bunk", bunk("Rear left bunk", -2.00, 2.45, 2.27, 1.02))

# The close right bunk is deliberately cropped by the camera.
scene.include("foreground_right_bunk",
              bunk("Foreground right bunk", 3.50, -2.15, 2.14, 1.04))

cabinet = Asset("Oak bedside wardrobe")
cx, cy = -.43, 4.33
add_box(cabinet, "back", (.94,.055,1.72), (cx,cy+.22,.94), (.25,.13,.045))
for j,x in enumerate((cx-.46,cx+.46)):
    add_box(cabinet, f"side_{j}", (.065,.49,1.74), (x,cy,.94), (.34,.185,.065))
    add_box(cabinet, f"foot_{j}", (.12,.38,.12), (x,cy,.075), (.22,.11,.035))
add_box(cabinet, "cornice", (1.08,.60,.075), (cx,cy,1.84), (.32,.18,.067))
add_box(cabinet, "cornice_lip", (1.12,.62,.032), (cx,cy,1.89), (.39,.23,.085))
add_box(cabinet, "base", (1.0,.55,.09), (cx,cy,.15), (.30,.15,.045))
add_box(cabinet, "middle_shelf", (.87,.49,.055), (cx,cy,.80), (.34,.19,.075))
# Left door; the right bay is open and dark.
add_box(cabinet, "left_door", (.43,.055,1.56), (cx-.225,cy-.27,.98), (.40,.235,.085))
for j,z in enumerate((.55,1.37)):
    add_box(cabinet, f"door_panel_{j}", (.32,.025,.59),
            (cx-.225,cy-.305,z), (.34,.18,.054))
add_rod(cabinet, "door_handle", (cx-.065,cy-.325,.95),
        (cx-.065,cy-.325,1.035), .012, (.13,.10,.045))
add_rod(cabinet, "hanging_bar", (cx+.04,cy,1.71),
        (cx+.40,cy,1.71), .012)
for j in range(3):
    x = cx+.11+j*.095
    add_rod(cabinet, f"hanger_left_{j}", (x,cy,1.65),(x-.06,cy-.01,1.55),.008)
    add_rod(cabinet, f"hanger_right_{j}", (x-.06,cy-.01,1.55),(x+.06,cy-.01,1.55),.008)
scene.include("wardrobe", cabinet)

# Fireplace: a deep black recess with soot-dark brickwork and heavy stone surround.
fire = Asset("Stone fireplace")
fx = 1.68
add_box(fire, "recess", (1.52,.035,1.24), (fx,4.535,.68), (.055,.047,.034))
for row in range(8):
    for col in range(6):
        x = fx-.68 + col*.255 + (.10 if row%2 else 0)
        if x < fx+.73:
            c = random.uniform(.09,.19)
            add_box(fire, f"brick_{row}_{col}", (.238,.055,.125),
                    (x,4.49,.16+row*.14), (c,c*.85,c*.65))
for j,x in enumerate((fx-.91,fx+.91)):
    add_box(fire, f"stone_pier_{j}", (.29,.34,1.32),
            (x,4.37,.70), stone)
    for k in range(3):
        add_box(fire, f"pier_joint_{j}_{k}", (.295,.345,.012),
                (x,4.37,.32+k*.39), (.28,.27,.21))
add_box(fire, "stone_lintel", (2.10,.38,.30), (fx,4.34,1.49), (.47,.45,.35))
add_box(fire, "mantel_edge", (2.20,.43,.065), (fx,4.31,1.66), (.43,.42,.32))
add_box(fire, "inner_top", (1.53,.15,.13), (fx,4.33,1.28), (.31,.30,.23))
add_box(fire, "hearth", (2.15,.78,.065), (fx,4.14,.033), (.26,.25,.19))
for j in range(4):
    add_box(fire, f"hearth_seam_{j}", (.012,.77,.003),
            (fx-.80+j*.54,4.14,.068), (.12,.12,.09))
scene.include("fireplace", fire)

radiator = Asset("Small pale radiator")
for j in range(8):
    x = 2.10+j*.035
    add_rod(radiator, f"rib_{j}", (x,4.02,.09), (x-.09,4.12,.58),
            .014, (.66,.70,.65))
add_rod(radiator, "top_pipe", (2.00,4.12,.58),(2.28,4.12,.58),.016,(.65,.68,.62))
add_rod(radiator, "bottom_pipe", (2.10,4.02,.09),(2.38,4.02,.09),.015,(.65,.68,.62))
scene.include("radiator", radiator)

bin_asset = Asset("Black hearth bin")
add_rod(bin_asset, "body", (2.73,4.03,.02),(2.73,4.03,.28),.10,(.055,.060,.052))
scene.include("hearth_bin", bin_asset)

clock = Asset("Small wall clock")
add_rod(clock, "rim", (-.48,4.52,2.27),(-.48,4.58,2.27),.125,(.43,.49,.42))
add_rod(clock, "face", (-.48,4.505,2.27),(-.48,4.515,2.27),.109,(.61,.67,.58))
add_rod(clock, "hand_one", (-.48,4.492,2.27),(-.48,4.492,2.335),.005,(.25,.28,.24))
add_rod(clock, "hand_two", (-.48,4.49,2.27),(-.435,4.49,2.25),.004,(.25,.28,.24))
scene.include("clock", clock)

# Small wall lamps above the beds.
for j,y in enumerate((.1,2.55)):
    lamp = Asset(f"Wall lamp {j}")
    add_box(lamp, "mount", (.07,.14,.22), (-3.16,y,2.25), (.16,.19,.16))
    lamp.include("shade", fillet_box(size=(.16,.16,.19), radius=.035,
                                    center=(-3.08,y,2.27), color=(.27,.32,.26)))
    add_box(lamp, "glass", (.025,.105,.09), (-2.988,y,2.26), (.72,.74,.60))
    scene.include(f"wall_lamp_{j}", lamp)

# All primitive sizes are positive; fillets fit the thinnest dimension.
# Repeated children have indexed keys. Materials are edited via group descendants.
realize(scene)
sc = bpy.context.scene
if sc.world is None:
    sc.world = bpy.data.worlds.new("Ambient world")
sc.world.use_nodes = True
sc.world.node_tree.nodes.get("Background").inputs["Color"].default_value = (.55,.60,.48,1)
sc.world.node_tree.nodes.get("Background").inputs["Strength"].default_value = .32

def descendants(obj):
    if obj.type == 'MESH':
        yield obj
    for child in obj.children:
        yield from descendants(child)

def texture_group(group_name, style):
    group = bpy.data.objects.get(group_name)
    if group is None:
        return
    for obj in descendants(group):
        for slot in obj.material_slots:
            if not slot.material:
                continue
            mat = slot.material.copy()
            slot.material = mat
            mat.use_nodes = True
            nodes = mat.node_tree.nodes
            links = mat.node_tree.links
            bsdf = nodes.get("Principled BSDF")
            bsdf.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = .78
            base = tuple(bsdf.inputs["Base Color"].default_value)
            tex = nodes.new("ShaderNodeTexNoise")
            tex.inputs["Scale"].default_value = 5 if style == "wood" else 15
            tex.inputs["Detail"].default_value = 3
            coord = nodes.new("ShaderNodeTexCoord")
            mapping = nodes.new("ShaderNodeVectorMath")
            mapping.operation = 'MULTIPLY'
            mapping.inputs[1].default_value = (26,1.4,5) if style == "wood" else (1,1,1)
            links.new(coord.outputs["Generated"], mapping.inputs[0])
            links.new(mapping.outputs[0], tex.inputs["Vector"])
            ramp = nodes.new("ShaderNodeValToRGB")
            ramp.color_ramp.elements[0].position = .17
            ramp.color_ramp.elements[0].color = tuple(v*.55 for v in base[:3])+(1,)
            ramp.color_ramp.elements[1].position = .83
            ramp.color_ramp.elements[1].color = tuple(min(v*1.3,1) for v in base[:3])+(1,)
            links.new(tex.outputs["Fac"],ramp.inputs[0])
            links.new(ramp.outputs["Color"],bsdf.inputs["Base Color"])
            bump = nodes.new("ShaderNodeBump")
            bump.inputs["Strength"].default_value = .24
            bump.inputs["Distance"].default_value = .018 if style == "wood" else .035
            links.new(tex.outputs["Fac"],bump.inputs["Height"])
            links.new(bump.outputs["Normal"],bsdf.inputs["Normal"])

texture_group("floorboards", "wood")
texture_group("timbers", "wood")
texture_group("wardrobe", "wood")
texture_group("architecture", "plaster")
texture_group("fireplace", "stone")

for group_name in ("near_left_bunk","rear_left_bunk","foreground_right_bunk"):
    group = bpy.data.objects.get(group_name)
    if group:
        for obj in descendants(group):
            for slot in obj.material_slots:
                if slot.material:
                    mat = slot.material
                    mat.use_nodes = True
                    bs = mat.node_tree.nodes.get("Principled BSDF")
                    color = bs.inputs["Base Color"].default_value
                    if max(color[:3]) < .2:
                        bs.inputs["Metallic"].default_value = .65
                        bs.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = .30

set_view(CAMERA, TARGET, lens=LENS, sensor=36)
area_emitter(position=(-2.2,-3.2,2.35), power=LIGHT_POWER, size=3.4,
             target=(-.7,1.5,.7), color=(.88,.94,1.0))
area_emitter(position=(1.6,1.0,2.7), power=140, size=3.0,
             target=(.3,4.4,1.2), color=(1,.88,.65))

sc.render.engine = 'CYCLES'
sc.cycles.samples = 48
sc.cycles.use_denoising = True
sc.render.resolution_x = 512
sc.render.resolution_y = 341
sc.render.resolution_percentage = 100
sc.view_settings.view_transform = 'AgX'
sc.view_settings.exposure = .25

def texture_group(name,style):
    group = bpy.data.objects.get(name)

        return

        for slot in obj.material_slots:
            if slot.material is None:
                continue
            mat = slot.material.copy()
            slot.material = mat
            mat.use_nodes = True
            nodes,links = mat.node_tree.nodes,mat.node_tree.links
            bs = nodes.get("Principled BSDF")
            bs.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = .76
            base = tuple(bs.inputs["Base Color"].default_value)
            coord = nodes.new("ShaderNodeTexCoord")
            mapping = nodes.new("ShaderNodeVectorMath")
            mapping.operation = "MULTIPLY"
            mapping.inputs[1].default_value = (26,1.4,5) if style=="wood" else (1,1,1)
            noise = nodes.new("ShaderNodeTexNoise")
            noise.inputs["Scale"].default_value = 5 if style=="wood" else 13
            noise.inputs["Detail"].default_value = 3
            links.new(coord.outputs["Generated"],mapping.inputs[0])
            links.new(mapping.outputs[0],noise.inputs["Vector"])
            ramp = nodes.new("ShaderNodeValToRGB")
            ramp.color_ramp.elements[0].position = .17
            ramp.color_ramp.elements[0].color = tuple(v*.62 for v in base[:3])+(1,)
            ramp.color_ramp.elements[1].position = .83
            ramp.color_ramp.elements[1].color = tuple(min(v*1.23,1) for v in base[:3])+(1,)
            links.new(noise.outputs["Fac"],ramp.inputs[0])
            links.new(ramp.outputs["Color"],bs.inputs["Base Color"])
            bump = nodes.new("ShaderNodeBump")
            bump.inputs["Strength"].default_value = .19
            bump.inputs["Distance"].default_value = .012 if style=="wood" else .022
            links.new(noise.outputs["Fac"],bump.inputs["Height"])
